# RFC-0002: Brazil fiscal core

> **Version:** 0.1.0 | **Status:** draft | **Phase:** spec
> **Owners:** @Gustavo-V-F

---

## 1. Summary

### [RFC-0002:C-SCOPE] Scope (Informative) <a id="rfc-0002c-scope"></a>

This RFC specifies how Akela issues and transmits Brazilian fiscal documents for its customers: any taxpayer in Brazil (a company, or an individual where the law allows, such as a rural producer), in any UF and municipality, issuing its own documents through Akela with its own digital certificate. Akela's own company may use the product the same way.

It covers: who issues and where the certificate lives; which documents, authorizers and municipalities are supported; numbering and series; offline contingency and retries; the authorizer status signal; document events; and how conformance is proven.

Out of scope, specified elsewhere: other countries; the tax calculation itself (rates, apportionment regimes, effective-dated tables); the domain operations that produce documents, specified in a later RFC; cloud-only Locations, specified with them; municipal NFS-e systems other than the national model. Location authority and recovery are defined in [RFC-0001](../rfc/RFC-0001.md). Terms are defined in [RFC-0002:C-TERMS](../rfc/RFC-0002.md#rfc-0002c-terms).

### [RFC-0002:C-TERMS] Terms (Informative) <a id="rfc-0002c-terms"></a>

- **Issuer**: the taxpayer that issues a document, identified by CNPJ, or by CPF where the law allows (for example a rural producer); in Akela, one per Location.
- **Authorizer**: the tax service that authorizes or generates a document: a UF's own SEFAZ, a shared virtual authorizer (SVRS, SVAN, SVSP), a contingency authorizer (SVC-AN, SVC-RS, SVC-SP), or the national NFS-e service (Sefin Nacional, with documents shared in ADN).
- **Homologation**: an authorizer's test environment, without legal validity; for the national NFS-e it is the restricted environment (Produção Restrita).
- **Reference case**: a document sent to an authorizer in homologation, stored with the authorizer's status code and reason.
- **DPS**: the service declaration that the issuer sends to Sefin Nacional; Sefin Nacional validates it and generates the NFS-e.
- **Reserved series**: a document series assigned to one machine for use only while it operates as primary after "Take over as primary" ([RFC-0001:C-MANUAL-RECOVERY](../rfc/RFC-0001.md#rfc-0001c-manual-recovery)).

---

## 2. Specification

### [RFC-0002:C-ISSUER-PER-LOCATION] One issuer per Location (Normative) <a id="rfc-0002c-issuer-per-location"></a>

Each Location MUST issue as exactly one issuer. Two Locations MUST NOT share an issuer.

Each issuer's documents MUST be signed with that issuer's own ICP-Brasil digital certificate.

### [RFC-0002:C-ISSUANCE-AT-LOCATION] Issuance only by the Location app (Normative) <a id="rfc-0002c-issuance-at-location"></a>

Fiscal documents MUST be issued and transmitted only by the Location app installation of the issuing Location.

No cloud service (Central Registry, CDC Receiver, Consolidated Postgres, Orchestrator) MAY hold an issuer's certificate or private key, or issue or transmit a document. Documents reach the Consolidated Postgres only after issuance, through CDC.

### [RFC-0002:C-COVERAGE] Supported authorizers and municipalities (Normative) <a id="rfc-0002c-coverage"></a>

Every authorizer of every UF, including the shared virtual and contingency authorizers, is in scope for NF-e, NFC-e, MDF-e and CT-e. Akela MUST issue these documents at every authorizer declared supported under [RFC-0002:C-SUPPORTED-AUTHORIZER](../rfc/RFC-0002.md#rfc-0002c-supported-authorizer).

NFS-e MUST be issued only through the national model (Sefin Nacional and ADN). This covers MEI, Simples Nacional ME and EPP in every municipality, and every company in municipalities that use the national issuer.

Municipal NFS-e systems kept under LC 214/2025 are not supported. A municipal system MAY be added, only by amending this RFC, for a municipality with a very large population or a very large number of companies.

When an issuer would need an unsupported authorizer or municipal system, Akela MUST refuse to issue and MUST say which authorizer or system is missing.

### [RFC-0002:C-SUPPORTED-AUTHORIZER] An authorizer is supported only with reference cases (Normative) <a id="rfc-0002c-supported-authorizer"></a>

An authorizer MUST be declared supported only after it has reference cases, from real homologation, for every document type and event Akela issues there.

Reference cases for an authorizer MUST be produced by an issuer that the authorizer accepts in homologation: for a UF's own SEFAZ, an issuer of that UF; for a shared virtual authorizer, an issuer of any UF it serves.

Reference cases come only from homologation. Support declared from them MUST NOT be presented as validated in production: production behaviour at an authorizer is validated only through a customer, or a separate entity that allows tests, issuing real documents there.

Issuance at an authorizer that is not declared supported MUST be refused as in [RFC-0002:C-COVERAGE](../rfc/RFC-0002.md#rfc-0002c-coverage).

### [RFC-0002:C-CONFORMANCE] Conformance comes from the authorizer (Normative) <a id="rfc-0002c-conformance"></a>

The expected result of every test of an authorizer's behaviour MUST be a stored reference case: the sent XML, the authorizer's status code and its reason. Such a test whose expected result has no reference case MUST fail.

Tests and data from third-party libraries MAY be used only as inputs, never as expected results.

When a new Technical Note or schema package applies to an authorizer, its reference cases MUST be resent in homologation and the responses compared with the stored ones before the change reaches production.

Legal rules that the authorizer does not check (contingency deadlines, document obligations by date or tax regime) MUST have tests derived from the legal text.

### [RFC-0002:C-NUMBERING] Numbering by the Leader (Normative) <a id="rfc-0002c-numbering"></a>

Documents and declarations with issuer-assigned numbers (NF-e, NFC-e, MDF-e, CT-e and the DPS) MUST be numbered per issuer, model and series, each series with its own sequence.

Only the Leader of the Location Cluster MAY assign a number in the Location's normal series ([RFC-0001:C-LEADER-AUTHORITY](../rfc/RFC-0001.md#rfc-0001c-leader-authority)). The same issuer, model, series and number MUST NOT be assigned twice, including while the Location is offline.

NFS-e numbers are assigned by Sefin Nacional. Gaps in an issuer's NFS-e numbering MUST NOT be reported as errors.

### [RFC-0002:C-RESERVED-SERIES] Reserved series per machine (Normative) <a id="rfc-0002c-reserved-series"></a>

Each machine that may operate as primary MUST have its own reserved series per model, including the DPS, unique among the issuer's machines and different from the normal series.

A reserved series MUST be used only while that machine operates as primary after "Take over as primary"; the majority side MUST keep using the normal series.

For NF-e and NFC-e, normal and reserved series MUST lie in the range NT 2023.002 assigns to the taxpayer's own software for the issuer's kind: 0–889 for a CNPJ issuer, 920–969 for a CPF issuer.

After reconciliation, the Location MUST return to the normal series from its last number. A reserved series MUST continue its own sequence the next time it is used.

### [RFC-0002:C-CONTINGENCY] Contingency issuance (Normative) <a id="rfc-0002c-contingency"></a>

When a document's authorizer cannot authorize it, the Location MUST be able to issue it in every contingency mode the legislation provides for that document:

- NF-e: SVC, EPEC (registered at the Ambiente Nacional) and FS-DA;
- NFC-e: offline contingency;
- CT-e: SVC, EPEC (model 57, registered at the SVC) and FS-DA;
- MDF-e: offline contingency.

SVC MUST be used only while the origin authorizer keeps it activated, and a document authorized by SVC MUST NOT be resent to the origin authorizer.

FS-DA MUST print the auxiliary document (DANFE or DACTE) on the Location's printer, on the security form, in the number of copies the legislation requires, leaving the form's fiscal area and pre-printed barcode untouched.

A contingency document MUST NOT reuse a number already transmitted in another emission mode.

Documents issued in EPEC, FS-DA or offline contingency MUST be queued at the Location and transmitted automatically when the authorizer becomes reachable, with retries until each has a final response. The Location app MUST warn before a queued document reaches its legal transmission deadline.

Cancellation of a document authorized in normal mode MUST wait until its origin authorizer is available again.

### [RFC-0002:C-NFSE-QUEUE] NFS-e queue and retries (Normative) <a id="rfc-0002c-nfse-queue"></a>

When Sefin Nacional cannot be reached or fails to answer, the DPS MUST stay queued at the Location and be retried automatically.

Before each retry, the Location MUST query Sefin Nacional by the DPS identifier, and MUST NOT resend a DPS whose NFS-e was already generated. No DPS MAY produce two NFS-e.

### [RFC-0002:C-AUTHORIZER-STATUS] Authorizer status signal (Normative) <a id="rfc-0002c-authorizer-status"></a>

Authorizer status received from the cloud's authorizer-status service MUST be treated as auxiliary.

Before switching to or from contingency, the Location MUST confirm the authorizer's state with the authorizer's own service-status query. Without that service, the Location MUST decide from the authorizer's responses alone.

NFS-e issuance MUST NOT depend on any availability signal.

### [RFC-0002:C-EVENTS] Document events (Normative) <a id="rfc-0002c-events"></a>

Akela MUST support, at every supported authorizer:

- NF-e and NFC-e: cancellation, and voiding of unused numbers (a separate service, not an event);
- NF-e only: correction letter (NFC-e rejects it, rejection 784);
- MDF-e: cancellation and closure;
- CT-e (model 57): cancellation, correction letter, EPEC (registered at the contingency authorizer, SVC), multimodal records, and delivery receipt and its cancellation.

For purchase NF-e, Akela MUST query received documents through the national distribution service and MUST register the recipient acknowledgement (awareness, confirmation, unknown operation, operation not performed) at the Ambiente Nacional.

### [RFC-0002:C-IBS-CBS-ONLY] IBS/CBS-only taxpayers (Normative) <a id="rfc-0002c-ibs-cbs-only"></a>

For an issuer that is an IBS/CBS-only taxpayer (no state registration, not an ICMS taxpayer; NT 2026.007), NF-e and the issuer's own NF-e events MUST be sent to SVRS whatever the UF, and NFC-e MUST NOT be issued for that issuer until 2033.

### [RFC-0002:C-REQUIRED-DATA] Required data per operation (Normative) <a id="rfc-0002c-required-data"></a>

Each operation that produces a document MUST declare the data it requires from each party.

The Location app MUST show, before issuance, which required data is missing and why, and MUST do so offline.
